reason: Chain-of-Thought prompting is performed at inference and improves reasoning accuracy by adding intermediate generated reasoning steps. The primary paper evaluates task accuracy, not inference serving, runtime efficiency, or memory/compression; longer reasoning can increase token generation. It is adjacent to inference-time methods but does not establish an inference-efficiency contribution, so retain as borderline rather than treating it as an in-scope systems paper.
title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models
